text:
alex: Quick heads-up: triage queue ballooned after the merge last night. 18 medium, 3 high (mixed SAST/DAST). Compliance wants an auditable chain for any auto-actions + an RBAC change request for scanner runners. Need a pragmatic plan.

tanya: +1. Proposal: any auto-action (assign/comment/close) must attach an evidence artifact: signed metadata + SHA256 of repro bundle. Store pointer to encrypted object in audit-bucket; never store raw payloads without explicit approval.

liam: On scanner auth: current runner uses a long-lived SA key with kms:Decrypt. We should replace with short-lived workload identity tokens (STS) and a conditional KMS grant proxy that issues scoped decryption tokens for test-only keys. Proxy logs requestor, PR and reason. Example request to proxy:
```bash
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/issue
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLOAD_JWT"
  -d '{"key":"keys/scan-test-1","purpose":"repro:5112349000","ttl":300}'
```

sec-bot: [scan-run] adhoc-dast/5112349000: 3 high (auth-redirect, ssrf) + 10 medium. Report: https://scans.redwood.int/reports/5112349000

oncall-sre: From oncall perspective: DO NOT page for every aging item. Page for P0/P1 immediately. For multiple P2/P3s, send an aggregated digest every 24h with: link, severity, owner, repro steps, runbook link. Keep the pager noise low.

compliance: Retention ask: metadata (events, signatures, pointers) must be retained for 36 months. Hashes are fine; full artifacts require exception. Also need signed audit entries (our audit key) for all ephemeral grants.

devops: We'll draft the RBAC change: rotate out long-lived SA, add iam:AssumeRole for GH App + ephemeral role for runners. Add CloudTrail-like audit stream with event shape: id, actor, action, resource, pr_number, timestamp.

alex: I sketched a GH Action that will: 1) call scanner; 2) write audit event; 3) create evidence pointer; 4) if threshold exceeded, call escalation webhook. Runs as GitHub App. Snippet:
```yaml
name: scan-triage
on: [pull_request, schedule]
jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          curl -X POST "$SCANNER_API/triage" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SCANNER_APP_TOKEN }}" \
            -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"}'
```

tanya: Important: GH Action must write audit event BEFORE making changes (idempotent write). Also action identity must be the GitHub App, not a user token.

liam: For the KMS proxy policy: only allow decrypt for specific key versions and only when request contains a valid evidence pointer + assigned reviewer. Deny for automated pages.

oncall-sre: Add a runbook link in the digest. Runbook should include: how to fetch evidence pointer, commands to revoke proxy tokens, and a checklist for escalation. Example verify command:
```bash
# verify audit event for PR triage
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ME" https://audit.internal/events?pr=5112349000 | jq '.[0] | {id,actor,action,timestamp}'
```

compliance: Please provide us a sample signed audit entry before rollout so we can sign-off. They want proof that ephemeral grants are recorded with PR id + signer.

devops: We'll prepare a migration plan for CI templates that reference SA keys. Plan: catchable deprecation window + GH Action to swap secrets.

alex: Action items I captured: 1) liam + devops: design KMS-proxy + RBAC changes (ETA Fri) 2) tanya + alex: GH Action + audit write (ETA Wed) 3) compliance: sample signed audit entry for sign-off (ETA Tue) 4) oncall-sre: digest format + runbook template (ETA Mon) 5) sec-bot: add aggregated digest posting (ETA next sprint). I'll open ISSUE-SEC-291 and link here.

tanya: One more: add a policy that auto-closing low-severity findings requires 2 approvals (security + code owner). Low risk auto-digest only after 7 days.

alex: noted. Thanks everyone :rocket:
